item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"To support free education, the government reportedly increased the education budget by 9.1% from 2021 to 2022 and by 23.9% from 2022 to 2023; the reported average teacher salary rose from 159,662.67 FC to 408,689.67 FC during the quinquennium.","notes":["The excerpt says «gratuité de l’enseignement» but does not specify primary education."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E013","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 29 September 2023, FAO and WFP reported that more than 25 million people in the DRC faced crisis or emergency food insecurity, over 5.6 million were displaced in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and conflict had disrupted agriculture and essential infrastructure while insufficient rural investment impeded food self-sufficiency. WFP faced a $629.6 million six-month funding shortfall.","notes":["The excerpt attributes disruption of agricultural production and infrastructure to conflict; it describes insufficient rural investment as a separate factor impeding food self-sufficiency."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0022-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
